source_audit.source_name: Historic England Heritage at Risk annual map/open-data services
source_audit.license: Open Government Licence v3.0 / Historic England open-data terms where stated; older 2016-2020 ArcGIS services are treated as source-row references with terms caveats.
source_audit.update_frequency: Annual register/map snapshots. Historic England states spreadsheets are available from 2013 onward and maps from 2016 onward.
source_audit.geographic_scope: England; this drop filters annual rows to ONS London region geometry E12000007.
source_audit.granularity: Annual HAR row with FID/uid/List_Entry/EntryName/Risk_Metho and point or polygon geometry depending on year.
source_audit.caveats: HAR presence is a risk-management/register status observation. This drop records first observed rows in the accessible 2016-2025 annual map series after a previous-year absence; it is not a repair/completion/causation claim and not necessarily the first ever at-risk assessment unless the annual additions spreadsheet confirms it.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Use only with annual-register/source-row wording; do not state physical works or causal reasons from HAR status alone.

source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Keep as provenance for the spatial filtering method.
